scene_analysis.scene_overview: A view of a modern office space with a large window overlooking a smaller office area. The main room has a white wall with a staircase leading up to the left and a counter with a computer monitor in front of it. There are two people working at desks inside the smaller office area. The ceiling is high with exposed beams and fluorescent lighting. The floor is made of large square tiles. A doorway to another room is visible to the right of the counter. The overall atmosphere is bright and clean.
